card.name: Quantity words in radiation dosing
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected amount or level, such as power, of after number or percent, and activity in radioactivity, mostly in radiopharmaceutical dosing text.

modes.label: Radioactivity amount
modes.description: The end of radioactivity or radiation phrases where a quantity such as MBq is about to follow.
modes.example: Recommended amount of radio<<activity>> of POSLUMA is 2

modes.label: Of after a quantity noun
modes.description: The word of after number or a percent, leading into a thing being measured.
modes.example: Administer the lowest number<< of>> particles possible, have emergency resuscitation

modes.label: Level of physical quantity
modes.description: Power or radiation as the noun being measured in general text.
modes.example: Most spacecraft communicate at a very low<< power>> - up to 20 times less

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning amount, quantity or strength.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to state how much of something, especially radioactivity.
